t: This is the London Welsh Centre on Gray's Inn Road, in Camden, a community and arts centre run by the London Welsh Trust. It began in 1920 as the Young Wales Association, and the person behind it was Margaret Lloyd George. She was a Welsh humanitarian and one of the first seven women magistrates appointed in Britain, in 1919. She was also the wife of Prime Minister David Lloyd George, from 1888 until her death in 1941.
